offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures ceiling and wall systems for commercial and residential buildings, sold through distributors and directly to contractors, architects and building owners. It makes panels and suspension grids in its own plants and sells them as branded building products.

primary_products.value: mineral fiber ceiling panels; metal ceiling systems; wall panels; suspension grid systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial contractors, architects, specifiers, building owners and developers

end_markets.value: commercial construction; renovation; healthcare; education; retail; office buildings

revenue_model.value: product sales: ceiling panels, grid systems and wall products sold to distributors and contractors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes ceiling and wall products from raw materials, sold to distributors and contractors; brand owner: markets its branded ceiling and wall systems to specifiers and building owners

geography_served.value: global: North America, plus Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: mineral fiber ceilings, metal ceilings, wall systems and suspension grids

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: ceiling and building materials distributors serving contractors; direct sales: national accounts and large contractors, architects and building owners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, fire-safety ratings and environmental rules for manufacturing and product emissions

notes: Business description reflects the company after the sale and spin-off of its flooring business; exact current segment mix and geographic split may vary.
